title: Mansion Luxury@Lakehouse Pool/Hot Tub for Big Fams
description:
AS SEEN ON CBS “STAYCATION! and Desperate Housewives” Escape to absolute paradise. Lakehouse Mansion with stunning outdoors, heated salt water pool & hot tub, 4 fire pits and 4 deck areas. For discerning travelers and yet a Family Favorite! 

Quiet and supremely serene…only 12 min from BNA and 17 min from downtown Nashville. 7500 sq ft home on 1.8 acres.

High-end throughout- 

2 tandem kayaks available!

1 min to the marina- rent a boat w/a slide!
5 min to 2 great golf courses!

❤️ CLEAN freaks

The space
Massive home with many sleeping areas. Everyone can have their own space, and yet gather in the 4 separate living rooms and two separate kitchens plus a kitchenette in loft.

Prepare to be amazed and mesmerized! It’s truly a new space!

High end home with high end furnishings including beds & sheets!

Guest access
Guests will be send a code the day of check in.

Other things to note
There is a charge to heat pool.

All activities are done at your own risk. There is no lifeguard on duty (duh) life jackets must be worn while in lake.

PLEASE ENSURE ALL GUESTS ARE CAPABLE SWIMMERS. NO CONSUMING ALCOHOL AND SWIMMING ANYWHERE, ANYTIME ON PROPERTY.

SWIM AT OWN RISK.
